Proposition
[Elementary Morrey inclusions] 1. ch7:7.46\group ch07-sobolev-spaces Source: gilbarg-trudinger:page-0176 For $1\leq p\leq \infty $, one has $L^p(\Omega )\subset M^p(\Omega )$. Moreover, $M^1(\Omega )=L^1(\Omega )$ and $M^\infty (\Omega )=L^\infty (\Omega )$.
Proof

\sketch Apply Hölder’s inequality on $\Omega \cap B_R$. At $p=1$ the defining bound is the $L^1$ bound, while at $p=\infty $ differentiation of integrals over shrinking balls identifies the essential supremum.

□
